name: Exp_BlauTStochI
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauTStochI (Blau Thermal Stochastic Indicator), a triple-smoothed momentum oscillator. It enters positions when the indicator either crosses zero (breakdown mode) or changes direction (twist mode), and manages trades with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauTStochI（Blau热随机指标）进行交易，该指标是一个三重平滑的动量振荡器。当指标穿过零轴（突破模式）或改变方向（扭转模式）时开仓，并使用固定的止损和止盈管理交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用BlauTStochI动量振荡器生成交易信号。BlauTStochI指标对价格动量进行三次平滑处理（分别使用XLength1、XLength2、XLength3三个周期），消除了短期噪音并捕捉中期动量趋势。入场条件分为两种模式：突破模式（breakdown）下，当指标从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空；扭转模式（twist）下，当指标方向从下转上时做多，从上转下时做空。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时也允许通过反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose权限控制）。仓位管理支持两种模式：按存款比例（MM参数为正）或固定手数（MM参数为负）。资金管理通过MMMode枚举选择LOT或其他保证金模式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并设置了最大价格偏差（Deviation）以控制滑点风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA generates trading signals using the BlauTStochI momentum oscillator, which applies triple smoothing (with periods XLength1, XLength2, XLength3) to price momentum, filtering short-term noise and capturing medium-term momentum trends. Entry conditions operate in two modes: breakdown mode triggers a buy when the indicator crosses above zero and a sell when it crosses below zero; twist mode triggers a buy when the indicator direction turns upward and a sell when it turns downward. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, while also permitting position closure via reverse signals controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose permission flags. Position sizing supports two approaches: deposit share allocation (positive MM parameter) or fixed lot size (negative MM parameter). Money management mode is selected via the MMMode enumeration, choosing between LOT and other margin calculation methods. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing redundant trades, and implements a maximum price deviation parameter (Deviation_) to control slippage risk.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例（正值）或固定手数（负值）
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点控制）

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法：突破零轴或方向扭转

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 三重平滑动量指标有效过滤短期噪音，信号质量较高
提供两种入场模式（突破和扭转），适应不同市场环境
有IsNewBar机制防止同K线重复开仓，控制过度交易
止损止盈参数明确，风险可控
支持双向交易并可通过开关独立控制多空方向的开平仓权限
pros_en: Triple-smoothed momentum indicator effectively filters short-term noise, producing higher quality signals
Two entry modes (breakdown and twist) provide flexibility for different market conditions
IsNewBar mechanism prevents redundant trades within the same bar, controlling overtrading
Explicit stop loss and take profit parameters make risk quantifiable and controllable
Bidirectional trading with independent permission switches for buy/sell open and close operations
cons: 依赖自定义指标BlauTStochI，若该指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）的动态调整
缺少加仓和减仓逻辑，仓位管理较为简单
未对spread进行过滤，在点差过大时可能产生不利成交
三重平滑导致指标滞后性较大，可能错过快速反转行情
cons_en: Depends on the custom BlauTStochI indicator file; EA fails to run if the indicator is missing
Fixed point stop loss and take profit do not adapt to market volatility (ATR) dynamically
No position scaling logic (adding or reducing), making position management simplistic
No spread filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during high-spread conditions
Triple smoothing introduces significant lag, potentially missing fast market reversals
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
增加点差过滤器，在spread超过阈值时暂停开仓
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add a spread filter to pause new position opening when spread exceeds a configurable threshold

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未根据波动率调整，在剧烈行情中可能止损过小或止盈过大
缺少spread过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利成交
三重平滑指标滞后性可能导致入场延迟，在快速行情中增加风险
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit not adjusted for volatility, risking insufficient stops or excessive targets during volatile markets
No spread filter means unfavorable fills during high-spread periods in volatile sessions
Triple smoothing indicator lag may cause delayed entries, increasing risk during fast market moves

summary_en: This EA trades based on the BlauTStochI (Blau Thermal Stochastic Indicator), a triple-smoothed momentum oscillator. It enters positions when the indicator either crosses zero (breakdown mode) or changes direction (twist mode), and manages trades with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
